claims.claim: The AutoKG repository provides code and data for a paper on LLMs for knowledge graph construction and reasoning.
claims.quote: Code and Data for the paper "[LLMs for Knowledge Graph Construction and Reasoning: Recent Capabilities and Future Opportunities](https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoKG/blob/main/Pdf/LLMs_for_Knowledge_Graph_Construction_and_Reasoning__Recent_Capabilities_and_Future_Opportunities1.pdf)"

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The work has three main components: basic evaluation, virtual knowledge extraction, and automatic KG.
claims.quote: The overview of our work. There are three main components: 1) _**Basic Evaluation**_: detailing our assessment of large models (text-davinci-003, ChatGPT, and GPT-4), in both zero-shot and one-shot settings, using performance data from fully supervised state-of-the-art models as benchmarks; 2) _**Virtual Knowledge Extraction**_: an examination of large models' virtual knowledge capabilities on the constructed VINE dataset; and 3) _**Automatic KG**_: the proposal of utilizing multiple agents to facilitate the construction and reasoning of KGs.
